'''RM-2020 espionage droids''' were a model from [[MerenData/Legends|MerenData]].

==Characteristics==
They were equipped with an espionage hardwired module, a barrel-shaped and roughly [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] body, an information recording/[[code]]d broadcasting system, a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] engine, [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] ([[Ultraviolet/Legends|ultraviolet]], [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]], analysis, and visual/audio), and a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]]. They were 1 meter tall and cost 160,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]<ref name="EGD" /> new (100,000 used on the black market). Their primary function was to gather intelligence on battlefields to bring back to bases. They could be programmed for sabotage and infiltrating enemy camps.

==History==
The droids were skilled with energy weapons, and [[Churhee's Riflemen]] modified several of the droids as combat units, only to have them confiscated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. An infamous RM-2020 was [[Armx]].
